description:
`scripts/generate-keymap` pipes `qmk json2c` straight into `save -f`:

  qmk json2c $tmp | lines | skip 1 | str join "\n" | save -f $"($dir)/keymap_generated.c"

The pipeline runs to completion before the external command's non-zero
exit surfaces, so a failed json2c writes 0 bytes over the committed
`keymap_generated.c`. Make only reports the error afterwards, by which
point the file is already gone.

Seen twice on 2026-09-06, both times because the container's bundled
`qmk` had no `json2c` subcommand until `qmk config user.qmk_home` was
pointed at the submodule. Recovered from git both times; on a dirty tree
there would have been nothing to recover from.

Fix: capture with `| complete`, check `exit_code`, and only `save` on
success. Clean up the temp file either way.
title: generate-keymap truncates keymap_generated.c when qmk json2c fails
